design: retrospective fixed-candidate, fixed-observation selector ablation; exposed development replay, not blind confirmation
goal: Preserve valid geometry and repair errors; quantify conditional contribution of simple point selection, uniform-gain gating and worst-case ranking.
baseline: photo_U11 frozen from previous evaluation; all arms KEEP it outside the 21 active requests

definitions.gain: g_c(z)=||a-C-z*r||^2-||c-C-z*r||^2; L(c)=min over frozen interval union; use historical exact affine outward-rounded kernel
definitions.P: merge intervals, use length-uniform mean (all zero length: distinct-singleton mean); choose greatest positive singleton gain lower bound
definitions.GP: same target and ranking as P, additionally require interval gain lower bound >0
definitions.R: same strictly positive interval-gain eligibility, rank by greatest lower bound
definitions.Q: highest mean of two reference-source NCCs among saved tracks, lower track ID tie; project saved triangulated reference depth to its own interval union (nearest, lower depth tie); rank saved candidates by positive singleton gain
definitions.QG: same target and ranking as Q, additionally require positive interval-gain lower bound over entire representation
definitions.old_replay: historical finite U11-bestpair scores, original incumbent -1, 0.05 incumbent improvement margin and >=5mm competing depth within 0.05 score veto
definitions.old_no_ambiguity: same old policy, remove only competing-depth veto
definitions.old_raw: same old policy, remove both competing-depth veto and 0.05 incumbent improvement margin; retain finite candidate-score requirements

old_bridge_exception: Old drop-gate policies deliberately start at the original historical incumbent to isolate deletion of existing rules, not at photo. If current photo is absent, modified old policies KEEP null. Finite-score old eligibility differs from all-coordinate new eligibility; this is not a common-interface evidence factorial.

evaluation.primary: mean over four ROI MSEs of nearest original DTU laser vertex distance, mm^2
evaluation.reuse: exact-coordinate cached distances, assert all 105 proposal plus 18 incumbent coordinates byte-equivalent as parsed floats; no new ground truth labels
evaluation.decomposition: Mphoto-MR=(Mphoto-MP)+(MP-MGP)+(MGP-MR), and analogous Q/QG. Arithmetic conditional contrasts in mm^2, NOT causal percentage shares.
evaluation.subgroup_use: descriptive only; no policy configuration selected using GT

lock: Protocol and source code plus GT-free inputs hashed before inference; predictions sealed before evaluation. Same fixed historical evidence; no new matching, threshold sweeps, candidates, or GPU.
reproduction: old_replay IDs equal all 21 historical photo IDs
R IDs equal all 21 saved decisions for star_full/star/cycle
stop: Run all 16 prespecified policies once, verify reproduction, evaluate every arm, audit independently. Do not add discriminating variants when arms agree.
limits: same exposed two scenes, not transfer
conditional ray-set squared gain differs from nearest-laser distance
uniform mean is an assumption, not calibrated posterior
old/new observations differ in patch model, scoring, and view budget; no causal factorial apportionment
